verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI video generation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Synthesia's hosted web app, cloud APIs, MCP and a 'fully managed' widget, with no on-premises or self-hosted deployment of the core product. The Interactive Avatars API, which lets users keep their own LLM and stack, is an integration building block and not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
